title: not working equipment anymore
symptom: Since 2 days, no Bluetooth connection; green LED on Bluetooth board blinks every 5 minutes, yellow light on wixel is on, no glucose values. Bluetooth scan in xDrip+ does not show the module, and system status shows 'not connected'.
cause: The thread suggests possible causes: the wixel may have corrupted firmware or died, the BT module may be faulty, or the xBridge may be paired via Android instead of only via xDrip. Also, the wixel may go to sleep after capturing a packet if it cannot connect to the phone.
fix: The thread suggests: ensure xBridge is not paired via Android, unpair if so; reload the .wxl firmware on the wixel; try flashing new firmware on the BT module; or replace the modules. Also, use the 'Forget Device' button in System Status to remove the xBridge, then rescan and select it.
evidence_quote: If the yellow light never flashes at all on the wixel then there is a problem there. Check wiring but also try reloading the .wxl firmware file. Sometimes they get corrupted, sometimes wixels completely die.
